title: Resident share against spend share
note: Note: Resident shares from Census 2011. R259m and R547m are reference points, not adopted targets. The R4m to R10m bar is drawn at R10m, and the 0.02% to 0.04% share is too small to draw to scale. SME and Community Inclusion Plan, Sep 2026, p5.
conflicts: None. All six values on SCIP p5 match v15 (18.4%, 15.4%, 0.02% to 0.04%, R4m to R10m, R259m, R547m).
lead_in: Set side by side, the communities' share of residents and their share of spend are far apart (Figure 2.24).
